title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 601 West Baker Road in Baytown, Texas, as the "Specialist Keith Erin Grace, Jr. Memorial Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 601 West Baker Road in Baytown, Texas, as the "Specialist Keith Erin Grace Jr. Memorial Post Office."

summary.headline: Names a Baytown, Texas post office building after Specialist Keith Erin Grace, Jr.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 601 West Baker Road in Baytown, Texas, as the "Specialist Keith Erin Grace, Jr. Memorial Post Office." It is an honorary designation. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 18, 2014, and the name took effect on that date.
